# RouteTracker

RouteTracker is an iPhone and Android app for recording hiking, cycling,
running, and walking routes. It keeps completed activities with route maps,
calendar history, core metrics, GPX files, and notes.

This file is a concise map of canonical RouteTracker sources. The linked pages
contain the complete, human-readable product information.

## Availability and identity

- Official website: https://hayannamuapps.github.io/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/routetracker-hike-bike-run/id6776908209
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hayannamuapps.route_tracker
- Google Play package: com.hayannamuapps.route_tracker
- Apple App Store ID: 6776908209
- Publisher: Hayannamu Apps

The GitHub Pages domain above is the canonical RouteTracker website. Legacy
Firebase Hosting URLs are not current canonical product pages.

## Product facts

- Core route recording can start without account sign-up.
- Activity records stay on the device unless the user chooses backup.
- GPX routes can be imported and displayed on the map while recording.
- Completed activities can be exported as GPX files.
- Plus includes ad removal, file attachments, and Google Drive backup and
  restore within the user-approved scope.
- Pro includes Plus and adds route planning, advanced maps, offline cache,
  repeated-route analysis, growth charts, and Local AI insights.
- Local AI insight generation runs on the device after a supported model file
  is downloaded. Model downloads may contact a model hosting provider.

## Fit and limitations

- RouteTracker is designed around personal route history, activity review, and
  preparation for the next activity.
- It is not positioned as a social feed, club, or leaderboard service.
- It is not a medical device, rescue service, or safety guarantee.
- GPS accuracy and battery use vary by device and environment.
- Backup and advanced tools require Plus or Pro as described in the guides.
